name: MLSC 4094W
title: Seminar in Medical Laboratory Sciences
description: Examination of case studies integrating all areas of the clinical laboratory in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disease. Design and implementation of a research project or investigation of a topic in Medical Laboratory Sciences. Oral and written presentation of research project or topic.
requirement_description: A grade of C or better in AH 4241; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open only to Medical Laboratory Sciences majors, others with consent of Program Director.
